payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sort lines by y-value at x1, then check if y-values at x2 are non-increasing; if an inversion exists, lines intersect inside (x1,x2).
payload.rationale: The solution maps each line to (y(x1), y(x2)), sorts by these tuples, and detects any decrease in y(x2). This is the standard custom sort key approach for strip intersection.
